the day you were born

Thursday, 8 November 2012

The world was busy that day, bujji, but the sky had its own plans 🌙

A waning crescent moon About 22% lit, just days before the new moon on 13 November (the Diwali new moon that year, which also brought a total solar eclipse over northern Australia).
🌑🌒🌓🌔🌕🌖🌗🌘
you arrived near the end of the cycle. Since then the moon has gone around the Earth about 173 times 🌙

the light in that picture left its galaxy 420 million years ago, long before dinosaurs ✨

meanwhile, in India…

📰 The newsOn the 8th, the Union Cabinet cleared a one-time spectrum fee of about ₹31,000 crore. The day before, Canada’s PM Stephen Harper had been touring Punjab, visiting Anandpur Sahib and tasting tilla kulfi in Chandigarh.
🪔 The festival seasonDiwali was just five days away (13 November). Shops were filling up with lights and gifts, and firecracker prices were climbing.
🌧️ The weatherCyclone Nilam had hit near Chennai about a week earlier, and its rains left parts of Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh flooded, with tens of thousands of people in relief camps. Up north, Delhi was around 29°C by day and 14°C at night, with an early-winter feel in the air.
🤝 The neighboursIndia and Pakistan were getting ready to start a new visa agreement, and had just agreed to bring back cricket matches between them after about four years.
🏏 The cricketEngland were in Ahmedabad playing a warm-up match against Haryana, a week before the India–England Test series began on 15 November. Cheteshwar Pujara had also just got engaged 💍
🎵 The musicSongs from Student of the Year were everywhere: “Ishq Wala Love”, “Radha”, and “The Disco Song”, a remake of Nazia Hassan’s 1981 classic “Disco Deewane”.
🎬 The moviesStudent of the Year was still in theatres, and everyone was counting down to Diwali, when Shah Rukh Khan’s Jab Tak Hai Jaan (Yash Chopra’s last film) and Ajay Devgn’s Son of Sardaar would open on the same day 🍿
🎮 The trendsMinecraft had only fully launched about a year earlier. Little did the world know you’d one day build in it with me 😭

you’ve been in this world for 5,113 days, and out of everything that happened that day, you’re still my favourite 💕

make a wish, bujji

Fourteen candles. Tap each one to blow it out.

14 left

Dear Bujji, Happy 14th birthday, my love! 🎉

Fourteen years ago the world got someone really special, and six months ago I got lucky enough to call her my girlfriend. Six months doesn’t sound like a lot, but it already feels like you’ve always been part of my days.

I know it’s hard that we’re so far apart. I can’t hug you today, or sit next to you while you blow out your candles, and honestly that sucks. But every call, every late-night talk, every silly Minecraft world and every good morning text makes the distance feel a little smaller. You make a screen feel like home, bangaram.

You’re my cutie, my bujji, my love, and yes, sometimes my dumbass too (lovingly, you know it). You laugh at my bad jokes, you stay up with me when you should be sleeping, and you make everything feel softer.

For your 14th year, I hope you get roses on the hard days, sunflowers on the ordinary ones, and a sky full of stars whenever you need one. I hope you’re proud of yourself, because I’m so proud of you.

One day the distance will be gone, and I’ll give you the biggest hug and a proper birthday celebration. Until then, we’re under the same moon, the same sky, and I’m yours.

Okay, I tried some Telugu for you (sorry, it’s still really bad 😭):
“Nenu ninnu chala miss avtunna, bujji. Nuvvu naaku chala ishtam. Nenu ninnu premistunna, naa bangaram!”

I love you so much. Happy birthday, my love.
Yours always 🌙
